investigation.when: alleged crimes, legal cases, jail/prison stories, fact-checking, event reconstruction, celebrity feuds
investigation.look: evidence-panel dossier: dark navy desk, paper documents, stamps, timeline

entertainment_magazine.look: glossy magazine: cream page, big type, pull quotes, issue furniture

vox_explainer.when: influence, comparisons, cultural context, analytical questions
vox_explainer.look: explanatory graphics on white: charts, comparisons, labelled diagrams

voice.style: Clear, natural and engaging, lively and confident, with clear articulation. Neutral on contested matters.

rules: confirmed fact, allegation, claim, rumour and opinion are labelled differently on screen
allegations are never stated as fact
no photo of a person unless a real, verified, licensed image was fetched; otherwise graphics
every claim traces to a fetched source
